cards.lore: Follows orders(BCL-2/P53). The Quiet Sacrifice — preventing viral punks or cancerous revolts.
cards.power: The Programmed Suicide. Arnie shrinks and packs his bags without waking the Immune Police.

cards.lore: Result of Ischemia/toxins. Triggers a Neutrophil-Riot (causing secondary neighbor damage).
cards.power: The Toxic Explosion. Splits DAMP-Guns everywhere.

cards.lore: Digests his own organelles to save metabolic rent. Efficient but weak.
cards.power: The Size-Reduction. Gets smaller to survive a Famine-Match.

cards.lore: A defensive move, but a Pre-Cancer-Risk that can evolve into Malignant-Mel.
cards.power: The Tissue-Swap. Replaces a sensitive wall with tough armor to survive chronic irritation.

cards.lore: Short-lived. Dies in the trenches, forming the Pus-Puddle of acute inflammation.
cards.power: The Kamikaze Attack. Arrives first to spray Oxygen-Bleach (Free Radicals).

cards.lore: The Director who presents the enemy's head to the T-Cell-Tacticians.
cards.power: The Garbage-Eater. Cleans Nathan's mess and decides if it's time for Building-Henry.

cards.lore: Type IV hypersensitivity — the wall breaks via immunosuppression, prisoners escape.
cards.power: The Eternal Prison. Builds a wall when Stubborn-Strep or Tuberculo-Tot can't be killed.

cards.lore: Provides strength but loses function — heart patched by Fiona won't pump.
cards.power: The Permanent Patch. Fills holes with Biological-Cement (Scar tissue).

cards.lore: Only danger is Pressure (e.g., in the Brain-Bunker where space is limited).
cards.power: The Slow-Growing. Just wants to grow in his own little bubble.

cards.lore: Cuts through walls and hitchhikes on the Lymph-Highway to reach distant lands.
cards.power: The Border-Breacher. Doesn't respect the Basement Membrane.

cards.lore: Stage IV war. Once Mitch colonizes, the Stain-Brigade rarely wins alone.
cards.power: The Global Colonialist. Sets up Sub-Malitias in distant organs.

cards.lore: If Peter is deleted (Li-Fraumeni), the Anaplasia-Assassins go completely unchecked.
cards.power: The DNA-Police. Checks blueprints for errors and calls Apoptosis-Arnie to end mutated cells.

cards.lore: If Livor is on the back but the body is face-down, the Scene-Scenery was tampered with.
cards.power: The Gravity-Stain. Shows where blood settled after the Heart-Pump stopped.

cards.lore: The Corpse-Handcuff that starts at the jaw and moves down.
cards.power: The Muscle-Lock. ATP-Batteries run out, and Calcium-Gates leak.

cards.lore: Used via the Henssge-Nomogram to build a Time-Since-Death clock.
cards.power: The Thermal-Drop. Cools the body to match the Arena-Temperature.

cards.lore: The natural Cleanup-Crew that turns the body green and distended.
cards.power: The Gas-Factory. Uses Internal-Bacteria-Punks to digest from the inside out.

cards.lore: Yellow/dry = happened after the bell. Red/crusty = happened during the fight.
cards.power: The Friction-Sign. Shows the direction of the Slide from a Scrape-Match.

cards.lore: Follows the Heme-Breakdown-Road (Hemoglobin → Biliverdin → Bilirubin).
cards.power: The Inner-Leak. A Hemorrhage-in-Hiding. Skin intact, but pipes broken underneath.

cards.lore: Hallmark of the Hammer or Fist (unlike an Incised clean cut).
cards.power: The Blunt-Force-Rip. Caused by crushing, leaving messy bridges behind.

cards.lore: Contact-Range shots leave a Muzzle-Stamp or Soot-Shadow on the skin.
cards.power: The Kinetic-Tunnel. Entrance-Gate is neat; Exit-Gate is a chaotic mess.

cards.lore: Death is usually from Brain-Ischemia, not a broken neck.
cards.power: The Gravity-Choke. Uses body weight to shut the Oxygen-Highway and Carotid-Pipes.

cards.lore: Causes Tardieu-Spots (petechiae) as veins are blocked but arteries keep pumping.
cards.power: The Hands-on-Halt. A Closer-Combat move.

cards.lore: Diatoms (algae) deep in the bone marrow prove the wrestler was breathing water before dying.
cards.power: The Fluid-Invasion. Fills the lungs with Arena-Water.

cards.lore: Kills the Electron-Transport-Chain. The victim suffocates despite O2-rich blood.
cards.power: The Mitochondrial-Jam. Stops Cellular-Engines from using oxygen; blood stays red because cells can't eat it.

cards.lore: Central-Veins flood with red while edges turn tan.
cards.power: The Backflow-Stain. Happens when Cardio-Carl fails and blood backs up into the Liver-sponge.

cards.lore: Misfolded proteins that body can't clear turn the organs into Stiff-Statues.
cards.power: The Protein-Clog. Amyloid-Alice deposits Sticky-Goo in the spleen.

cards.lore: The inflammation makes the heart scratch against its housing (friction rub).
cards.power: The Rough-Surface. Coats the heart in Fibrin-Glue.

cards.lore: Renal-Pipes block with pink goo, appearing like Thyroid-Tissue under the scope.
cards.power: The Kidney-Contractor. Turns the kidney into a Micro-Lump after too many UTI-Uprisings.

cards.lore: The Death-Spiral. If Lungs (ARDS) and Kidneys (ATN) fail, the match is lost.
cards.power: The Global Shutdown. Occurs when Total-Pressure fails and all organs starve.

cards.lore: Loves the Big-Toe-Ring. Podagral. Rich Purine snacks are his fuel.
cards.power: The Toe-Torture. Drops Uric-Acid-Needles into Joints, joining an Inflammation-Riot.

cards.lore: A Type III hypersensitivity Immune-Complex war.
cards.power: The Self-Sabotage. Her immune-army gets confused and attacks the Kidney-Filters and Skin-Shield.

cards.lore: A mysterious immune-revolt that loves to hide in the Lung-Gates.
cards.power: The Mystery-Lump. Builds Granuloma-Gerry's everywhere, but crucially without the Caseous-Center.

cards.lore: If Al's wall pops, he triggers the Clot-Monster for a Heart-Halt.
cards.power: The Pipe-Narrower. Builds Gunk-Walls inside arteries, slowing Oxygen-Traffic.

cards.lore: A Berry-Burst causes a sudden Thunderclap-Headache.
cards.power: The Weak-Wall-Balloon. Stretches the Pipe-Armor until it bursts.

cards.lore: Born in a moving stream = Lines of Zahn. Born after death = Currant-Jelly.
cards.power: The Static-Stoppage. Builds a Blood-Dam that halts flow completely.

cards.lore: A Saddle-Embolus blocks the main Lung-Highway, ending the match instantly.
cards.power: The Long-Distance Strike. A piece of Thrombus that breaks free to jam a Smaller-Pipe.

cards.lore: Loss of Snap (Elasticity). Can get air in, but can't get it out (Pink-Puffer).
cards.power: The Wall-Dissolver. Eats the Alveolar-Balloons into useless, flabby Air-Sacs.

cards.lore: Chronic irritation leads to Gland-Expansion, the king of the Smoker's Cough.
cards.power: The Mucus-Flood. Fills Airway-Tunnels with blue sludge.

cards.lore: Gray Hepatization: RBCs die but the fibrin-armor stays, permanently stealing the Air-Space.
cards.power: The Liquid-Lung. Fills the Air-Balloons with pus/blood until the lung is Solid like a liver.

cards.lore: Macro-Maggies eat the dust but die, calling Fibro-Fiona to build a permanent scar-tomb.
cards.power: The Sand-Lung. Breathing Rock-Dust turns soft lungs into hard, scarred stone.

cards.lore: Post-Strep Nate is a Type III War. Immune-Complexes riot in the filter.
cards.power: The Clogged-Filter. Inflames the Glomerulus-Grit until blood leaks and the Pressure-Alarm sounds.

cards.lore: MCD-Molly (Minimal Change Disease) attacks junior wrestlers, erasing the Podocyte-Feet.
cards.power: The Sieve-Leak. Filter is so broken that all the Albumin-Gold drains out, causing whole swelling.

cards.lore: Most common cause of Acute Renal Failure. If the host survives, pipes can regrow.
cards.power: The Pipe-Melt. Renal-Pipes die and fall apart, clogging the system with Muddy-Debris.

cards.lore: Clear Cells are full of lipids. Ray is a Vascular-Master who builds his own blood supply.
cards.power: The Yellow-Invasion. A bright yellow tumor that loves to grow into the vein and travel to the heart.

cards.lore: Blue means Acid-Lover (DNA/RNA); Pink means Base-Lover (Cytoplasm).
cards.power: The Pink-and-Blue Vision. Provides the Standard-Map of Punk-Villain-Battlefield.

cards.lore: A thick Basement Membrane glows as a solid, unmistakable bright magenta line.
cards.power: The Glycogen-Glow. Highlights everything sugar: Basement Membranes, Fungal Punks, Sugar-Stores.

cards.lore: Used to find where Hank-Hemorrhage was hiding or to catch iron-overload.
cards.power: The Rust-Finder. Turns hidden Iron-Stores (Hemosiderin) bright blue.

cards.lore: CD20+ = B-Cell-Brawler. CK7+ = Epithelial-Elite. Isaac never guesses; he proves it.
cards.power: The Identity-Tag. Uses Special-Key-Antibodies to unlock the true name of an Anaplastic tumor.

cards.lore: The very first step of the Sectio-Session. Everything starts with Yoda.
cards.power: The Total-Access. Opens the Body-Box to expose all the organ-tenants.

cards.lore: Preserves the Connections to see if a Bile-Bandit escaped into the blood.
cards.power: The Block-Lift. Removes all the tenants in one connected package.

cards.lore: The Old-School way. Perfect for hunting tiny pneumonias deep in the lung.
cards.power: The Detail-Cut. Takes organs out one-by-one and slices them to find Hidden-Scars.

cards.lore: Vitreous-Humor is the ultimate vault for sugar or alcohol — it stays clean the longest.
cards.power: The Ghost-Hunter. Finds the Chemical-Saboteurs the eyes can't see.

cards.lore: Inflammation, infarction, or infection? Show me the Basement membrane!
cards.power: The Morphological-Oracle. The eyes see what the mind knows.

cards.lore: Identify the Pump-Failer (Cardio-Carl) and explain why the liver looks like a spice.
cards.power: The Backwards Flow.

cards.lore: Explain the connection between the Pipe-Gunk and the Brain-Bleed in a Berry-Annie burst.
cards.power: The Plaque-Pressure.

cards.lore: Identify the syndrome and name the character responsible for erasing the Podocyte-Feet.
cards.power: The Melted Feet.

title: Pathology & Forensic Medicine: The Post-Mortem Posture
